# PinningException

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish.Ipfs` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class PinningException : Exception
```

A pinning service refused, failed or answered with something unusable. The message is worded for the person who asked, and both front-ends show it verbatim.
